headline: 《Fund》00406A Sees Huge Volume Surge! Pays NT$0.138 Dividend, Annualized Yield 17.1% - Finance
summary: Asian stocks broadly declined after Federal Reserve Chair Warsh released hawkish signals, and Taiwan stocks closed lower on the 31st.
why: The Federal Reserve sets US interest rates, and hawkish signals tend to lift global yields and pressure equity valuations in other markets, including Asia.
why_moved: Federal Reserve Chair Warsh released hawkish signals, which dragged Asian stocks broadly lower on the 31st, and Taiwan stocks closed in the red.
